name: Painting
overview: Scripture acknowledges the art of painting both as a skill given by God and as a cultural practice. God appointed Bezaleel, endowed with wisdom and craftsmanship, to create intricate works including embroidery and engraving, demonstrating divine approval of artistic skill (Exodus 35:30, 35:35). Painting is also mentioned in the context of personal adornment, such as Jezebel painting her face to enhance her appearance (2 Kings 9:30) and the vain use of painting to mask ruin or sin (Jeremiah 4:30). Additionally, painting and marking are associated with craftsmanship in making objects and decorating rooms, reflecting an ordered and purposeful creativity (Isaiah 44:13).
